name: What are common home renovation mistakes to avoid?

mainEntity.name: What are common home renovation mistakes to avoid?

acceptedAnswer.text: Avoid underestimating costs, skipping permits, mixing DIY with licensed work improperly, and neglecting to plan for waste removal and site cleanup. A detailed plan and communication with your contractor mitigate these risks.
